title: synonymy
description: The equivalence relation on predication settlings over a common base that holds exactly when they are mutually-locally-derivable (equivalently cohomologically equivalent); generated by closing mutually-local-derivability into the coarsest structural equivalence respecting the settling endofunctor's inferential dynamics.

equivalence-relation.description: ~_syn is reflexive, symmetric, and transitive; its classes are the connected components of the settling fiber groupoid KP^simeq(B) and form the coarse settling moduli |KP^vis(B)|

structural-not-value.description: synonymous settlings are related by an invertible settling-morphism commuting with both closure endofunctors up to ordinal shift delta, so they share inferential dynamics, not merely static values

biequivalence-collapse.description: v ~_syn v' iff v ~_MLD v' iff v ~_H v'; the biequivalence-cohomological-collapse theorem makes the two defining conditions coincide on every regime stratum
